verdict.rationale: Messenger access is a fair question for an AI assistant product. However, the evidence pack documents no WhatsApp, Telegram, Discord, Slack, or iMessage integration. The embeddable website chat widget and the developer API are adjacent features or building blocks, not native messenger surfaces, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an everyday user, I can talk to my assistant from the messengers I already use — WhatsApp, Telegram, Discord, Slack, or iMessage — not just a bespoke web page
